title: “Welcome to Gab”: Alt-Right Discourses
reasoning: The paper is a sociological study that uses Structural Topic Modeling (an NLP technique) to analyze user-generated content on the Gab platform. It identifies themes related to extremism, anti-Semitism, and anti-feminism to understand the community's discourse. It does not evaluate, benchmark, or study the ethical reasoning, moral judgment, or biases of the NLP model itself, nor does it involve Large Language Models (LLMs).
